data.gender_notes: Blane is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Blane is derived from the Anglo-Saxon word 'blaen,' meaning 'blithe' or 'cheerful.' It can also be interpreted as 'slender.' This name holds a sense of optimism and joy. The name Blane carries the meaning “Blithe, cheerful, or slender” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Blane usually hope their child will grow to embody blithe, cheerful, or slender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Blane belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blithe, cheerful, or slender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Blane total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
